p: subtil than any beast of the: As Satan can change himself into an angel of light, so did he abuse the wisdom of the serpent to deceive man.
said unto the woman: God allowed Satan to make the serpent his instrument and to speak through him.
lest ye die: In doubting God's warnings she yielded to Satan.
die: This is Satan's chiefest subtilty, to cause us not to fear God's warnings.
knowing good and evil: As though he said, God forbids you to eat of the fruit, only because he knows that if you eat of it, you will be like him.
did eat: Not so much to please his wife, as moved by ambition at her persuasion.
knew that they were naked: They began to feel their misery, but they did not seek God for a remedy.
hid themselves from the presence of: The sinful conscience flees God's presence.
naked: His hypocrisy appears in that he hid the cause of his nakedness, which was the transgression of God's commandment.
gavest to be with me: His wickedness and lack of true repentance appears in this that he blamed God because he had given him a wife.
The serpent beguiled me: Instead of confessing her sin, she increases it by accusing the serpent.
Because thou hast done this: He asked the reason from Adam and his wife, because he would bring them to repentance, but he does not ask the serpent, because he would show him no mercy.
dust shalt thou eat all the: As a vile and contemptible beast, Isa 65:25.
thee and the woman: He chiefly means Satan, by whose action and deceit the serpent deceived the woman.
head: That is, the power of sin and death.
bruise his heel: Satan shall sting Christ and his members, but not overcome them.

sorrow and thy conception: The Lord comforts Adam by the promise of the blessed seed, and also punishes the body for the sin which the soul should have been punished for; that the spirit having conceived hope of forgiveness might live by faith. 1Co 14:34.
cursed is the ground for thy: The transgression of God's commandment was the reason that both mankind and all other creatures were subject to the curse.
Thorns also and thistles shall it: These are not the natural fruit of the earth, but proceed from the corruption of sin.
make coats of skins: Or, gave them knowledge to make themselves coats.
Behold: By this derision by reproaches Adam's misery, into which he was fallen by ambition.
take also of the tree of: Adam deprived of life, lost also the sign of it.
